Select distinct chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles for all molecules linked to document CHEMBL1123890. Resolve the document via chembl_id_lookup, join compound_records on doc_id to get molregno and compound_name, join molecule_dictionary on molregno for chembl_id, and inner join compound_structures on molregno for canonical_smiles (only include rows where canonical_smiles is present). Return distinct rows. Sort by chembl_id, then compound_name, then canonical_smiles.
